jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

You will lead complex, multidisciplinary industrial CAPEX projects in production, infrastructure and R&D environments, covering the full lifecycle from concept and feasibility through commissioning and handover. The scope includes both new installations and major modifications to existing process-industry assets.

• Take end-to-end ownership of industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility to commissioning and operational handover.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases: pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, site execution, commissioning and handover.
• Act as the single point of accountability for stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary internal and external teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims and deviations affecting budget or schedule.
• Report progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.
• Ensure quality and safety standards are maintained throughout execution.

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Manager with proven A-Z ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• Minimum 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil.
• Demonstrated experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies.
• Demonstrated experience with CAPEX budgeting and investment approval.
• Demonstrated experience with commissioning industrial installations.
• Mandatory experience in the process industry.
• Strong hands-on experience with MS Project, including ownership of project planning.
• Academic working level with strong analytical skills and helicopter view.
• You work autonomously, take full ownership and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You have the authority to challenge stakeholders and contractors in complex industrial environments.
• VCA-Vol is mandatory; PMP or Prince2 is a plus.
• Fluent Dutch and English are required.
• On-site presence in Olen is required.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Weekend Production Operator – Flexible Schedule, Attractive Pay, and Career Growth
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Sales Advisor Toyota City / Lexus Zaventem
jobs.description:
About us

Inchcape is the leading global automotive distributor operating in +40 markets. We partner with some of the biggest brands in the business to sustainably power better mobility today and in the future.

Our diverse global team of over 16,000 talented colleagues foster an inclusive and collaborative culture, delivering a brilliant experience for our customers and partners. We're a dynamic and fast-growing business, driving the transformation of our industry and redefining tomorrow.

Inchcape Belux employs over 250 team members. Our portfolio includes vehicle distribution for world-renowned brands, market leading fulfilment solutions, exceptional retail experiences, and tailored financial services.

 

Do you want to develop world-class skills, build a brilliant career, and thrive within a highly supportive team? Join Inchcape Belux, part of Inchcape's global network.

You'll play a key role in delivering outstanding customer experiences while representing one of the world's most trusted automotive brands. You'll be part of a dynamic team where collaboration, performance, and customer satisfaction are central.

Our Toyota City Zaventem team is looking for a Sales Advisor New Cars to support the sales of new Toyota and Lexus vehicles. In this role, you will guide customers throughout their buying journey, actively manage leads, and ensure a seamless and professional sales experience.

What you'll do
 
• Drive showroom sales for both B2B and B2C customers. 
• Actively prospect and develop new fleet clients while ensuring close follow‑up of all B2B and B2C leads. 
• Handle daily leads in line with brand standards and deliver strong performance on mystery leads, emails, calls, visits, and test drives. 
• Deliver excellent customer experience by informing, advising, and following up professionally, building long‑term trust and satisfaction. 
• Act as a Toyota Brand Ambassador in the showroom, during events, and on social media, with a polished appearance and courteous behaviour. 
• Apply Toyota's Omotenashi principles to create a warm, personalised customer experience. 
• Ensure flawless test drives and a smooth, high‑quality delivery process for customers. 
• Upsell additional products and services such as financing, insurance, and accessories. 
• Complete all administrative tasks accurately and in line with internal procedures. 
• Contribute to high customer recommendation and online reputation scores by consistently delivering top‑tier service. 
 

 

About you

To be successful in this role you will be:
 
• Passionate about the automotive industry and eager to build a career in sales. 
• Results‑driven and proactive, motivated to seize every sales opportunity. 
• Experienced in a customer‑facing role where customer satisfaction was the top priority. 
• Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced environment. 
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good knowledge of English.

Team/division description:

You will be working for the Human Resources division, called People & Innovation. You will be part of the Data Analytics and HR Solutions team (part of Business Innovation within P&I). Our main purpose is to ensure HR data is accurate, governed, business-relevant, and transformed into trusted analytics and reporting solutions by acting as the primary bridge between HR business stakeholders, IT data teams, and reporting developers.

At P&I we strive to deliver effective solutions towards business leaders and our Pan-E regional HR counterparts. Listening to the customer is essential to developing adequate and efficient solutions.

Your responsibilities

Your role is to support building foundation and contribute to strong employee experiences.

 
• 
HR Data Governance & Data Quality

 
• 
Business Analysis within HR Data Domain

 
• 
Bridge between HR and ITD Data Product Delivery Team

 
• 
Overview Snowflake operations (catalogue, ingest, semantic modelling design)

 
• 
Managing Power BI Reporting Portfolio (prioritisation and budget control)

 
• 
Stakeholder Management (withing HR areas and business)

 
• 
Monitoring testing and release management

 
• 
Ensure compliance, privacy & security rules are followed

Your profile:

 
• 
English (Professional/Business Fluency), other languages are also an asset.

 
• 
Experience with Snowflake, Collibra and Data Product creation is essential for this role

 
• 
Knowledge of SQL, Qlick, Power BI is an asset

 
• 
Stakeholder Management

 
• 
Able to work with HR executives, HR operations teams, Data engineers, Solution architects, BI developers, Vendors

 
• 
Strong ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive summaries, present risks and recommendations.

 
• 
Our ideal candidate can facilitate workshops, and liaise with multinational teams

 
• 
The ideal candidate has a natural interest in the customer voice. They have proven similar past experiences, in the field of data governance, analytics, AI solutions design.

 
• 
Must be able to challenge assumptions, connect data across systems, identify root causes, spot inconsistencies.
